title: Savings Membership Enrollment Standard
content:
# Enrollment Standard — Dental and Vision Savings Memberships

## Clause 1 — Who the membership is sold to

A Dental and Vision Savings Membership is sold only to a primary member who:

1. is at least the minimum age set in the membership's entry requirements;
2. resides in one of the states where the membership is sold; and
3. enrolls no more persons than the number of persons the membership may cover, the household members being those of the membership's household definition.

Every enrollment carries the disclosure that the membership is not insurance.

## Clause 2 — Activation

The membership activates the number of activation business days set for the membership after the first fee is paid in full. On activation the membership moves from pending activation to active, and the discounts become usable. There is no waiting period, no visit limit and no exclusion for existing conditions.

## Clause 1 restated as a check of the sale

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| Age | The primary member is at least the membership's minimum age |
| Residence | The primary member resides in a state where the membership is sold |
| Persons | The persons enrolled do not exceed the persons the membership may cover, and they fall within its household definition |
| Disclosure | The enrollment carries the not-insurance disclosure |

All four rows apply together: the membership is sold only when each of them is met.

## Illustrative cases (hypothetical)

- A primary member who meets the age and residence requirements enrolls a household within the membership's person limit, with the disclosure given: the sale meets Clause 1.
- A primary member residing in a state outside the states where the membership is sold: the membership is not sold.
- An Individual membership requested for the primary member and a second person: the persons exceed what that membership may cover, and it is not sold on those terms.
- On the business day that is the membership's number of activation business days after the day the first fee was paid in full, the membership activates; on any earlier business day it is still pending activation and its discounts are not yet usable.
- A first fee paid only in part: activation has not been reached, since the activation period counts from the first fee paid in full.
